title: PyTorch FSDP: Fully Sharded Data Parallel
description: FSDP is PyTorch-native ZeRO-3: it shards model parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across data-parallel workers, and all-gathers them just-in-time during forward/backward passes. Unlike DeepSpeed ZeRO, it is fully integrated into PyTorch's autograd and module system. Used to train LLaMA 1/2/3, OPT, and other Meta models.
authors: Zhao, Gu, Varma, Luo, Huang, Xu, Wright, Shojanazeri, Ott, Shleifer, Rayner, Ma, Nguyen, Chauhan, Hao, Mathews, Chintala (Meta)
